script_text: If someone says these 3 phrases, walk away. Manipulators reuse the same scripted lines in every argument. Phrase one: 'you're overreacting' — it makes you doubt your own read of the situation. Phrase two: 'I never said that' — pure gaslighting to rewrite what happened. Phrase three: 'after everything I've done for you' — guilt used as a weapon. The counter is one calm sentence: name the tactic out loud, and it stops working.
